name: extended
description: Adds the RealMedia demuxer and software decoders for codecs Apple does not decode (MPEG-1/2/4, H.263 and Flash video, WMV, RealVideo, VP6/VP8/VP9, Theora) and AV1 through dav1d. H.264 is never software-decoded: Hi10P is out of scope. VC-1 stays off until legal clearance (D-E8). The core binary already demuxes AVI, FLV, ASF and Ogg (container work needs no codec licence), but the plan reports those containers as needing this module (ANM-8: the Pro formats), so a host gates them like the codecs. Shipped as a variant binary (RESEARCH.md section 24, decision D-E11).

mpeg4.note: MPEG-4 Part 2 (Xvid/DivX); last patent reportedly expired 2026-07 (single source)

wma.note: WMA is not built in version 1: the engine converts audio segment by segment, and WMA's frames reach across packets, which needs a different alignment (deferred, see docs/PROGRESS.md); the decoder is left out

h263.note: H.263 and Sorenson Spark (FLV1); patents reported expired, confirm in LIC-6 review

vp6.note: On2 VP6 (FLV); not a committed royalty-free codec, check before enabling

rv.note: RealVideo 1.0-4.0 (RMVB); RealNetworks codecs, status unverified, check before enabling

cook.note: RealAudio Cook, RA 1.4k/2.8k: not built in version 1 for the same reason as WMA, and status unverified

adpcm.note: MS ADPCM and IMA ADPCM in WAV/AVI; old, no known live claims

avi.note: demuxer is in core; the plan reports the container as needing the extended module so a host can gate it (ANM-8)

flv.note: demuxer is in core; the plan reports the container as needing the extended module so a host can gate it (ANM-8)

rm.note: RealMedia demuxer (extended only); the plan reports the container as needing the extended module (ANM-8)

asf.note: demuxer is in core; the plan reports the container as needing the extended module so a host can gate it (ANM-8)

av1.note: AOMedia royalty-free patent licence; only used when the device has no AV1 hardware decoder

mp2.note: MPEG-1 Audio Layer II (MP2): the patents ran out with those of MP3 and MPEG-1; confirm in the LIC-6 review

components.name: dav1d
components.note: AV1 software decoder (VideoLAN), linked statically into the extended FFmpegLGPL binary; its licence text ships in the framework's Resources/licenses
